ids.description: The cases that you want to removed. To get the case identifiers, use the search cases (`_find`) API. In the Dev Console, you can specify the array of cases in the following format: `ids=["e58e77e3-ef8e-4251-926f-efb115f3c4ec"]`. In `curl`, all non-ASCII characters must be URL encoded. For example: `ids=%5B%22e58e77e3-ef8e-4251-926f-efb115f3c4ec%22%5D`
